title: A sale on the vest day takes the oldest parcel, so a nil gain becomes a gain
found: Danny holds 120 older units and sells each new parcel the day it vests. Lots match oldest first, so FY2027 derives $400.45 of net capital gain that did not happen. L11 catches the gap against the lodged return.
want: A sale on the day of a vest matches that vest's parcel, or the choice of parcel is a question. Which parcel is sold is the taxpayer's to identify.
